description: Submit a feature request to Replo when the user asks to send feedback about a missing capability. Provide the projectId, a short title, and a concise description of the requested capability. Do not include conversation transcripts, verbatim messages, message references, credentials, or unrelated personal or customer data. Creates one feedback record for Replo's team; retries after success create duplicates.

description.description: Concise description of the requested Replo capability. Exclude conversation history, verbatim messages, message references, credentials, and unrelated personal or customer data.

title.description: Short headline for the feature request.
